a: Providers plug Terraform into APIs (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.).
State maps resources to real infrastructure; store it remotely and lock it.
terraform plan shows what will change without applying.
terraform apply executes the planned changes.
Workspaces separate state for environments like staging/prod.
Drift is when real infra diverges from declared code.
Import brings existing resources under Terraform management.
Pulumi is IaC using general-purpose languages instead of HCL only.
CloudFormation is AWS-native infrastructure as code.
